title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 17th August 2026 || TV5 Money

recommendations.note: Result on expected lines (one-time product revenue drop-off). Stock held well, only 3-4% correction. Opportunity to buy for the next round.
recommendations.detail: Viewer Sravan Reddy asked about Natco with 1,000 shares at Rs 890. Kutumba Rao replied the result came on expected lines -- the weakness from the single-product one-time returns was anticipated. 'The stock has held, not fallen much. I think it is giving an opportunity to buy for the next round. Do not sell. Closer to the 850-860 band, buy.'

recommendations.note: Buy for 1-2 years. Suggested at recent workshops. Multiple support points near 500.
recommendations.detail: Viewer Gurram Soujanya asked if Archean Chemicals can be bought at current levels for 1-2 years. Kutumba Rao said: 'It can be bought. We have suggested this stock in two or three recent workshops as well.' Ramakrishna added to wait for 490-500 support confirmation.

recommendations.note: Buy. No reservations alongside Shilpa Medicare.
recommendations.detail: Viewer Chiranjeevi wanted to buy Biocon and Morepen and asked about Shilpa Medicare. Kutumba Rao said: 'Biocon and Shilpa -- I would say buy.'

recommendations.note: Buy. Viewer already in profit; Kutumba Rao says keep buying.
recommendations.detail: Part of the same question from Chiranjeevi. Kutumba Rao grouped Shilpa Medicare with Biocon as buys: 'Biocon and Shilpa -- I would say buy.'

recommendations.note: Avoid at current levels. Already jumped significantly.
recommendations.detail: Part of the same question from Chiranjeevi. Kutumba Rao said: 'Morepen -- I would say avoid. It has already jumped significantly. At current levels, avoidable.'

recommendations.note: Top priority among four hospital stocks asked about (KIMS, Apollo, Yadarth, Narayana).
recommendations.detail: Viewer Ishwaraiah asked which of KIMS, Apollo Hospitals, Yadarth Hospitals, and Narayana Hrudayalaya to pick. Kutumba Rao said: 'KIMS and Yadarth -- on priority basis.'

recommendations.note: Priority pick along with KIMS among four hospital stocks.
recommendations.detail: Part of the same question from Ishwaraiah. Kutumba Rao named KIMS and Yadarth as the priority picks, excluding Apollo Hospitals and Narayana Hrudayalaya.

recommendations.note: Definite buy. No fear at all. Signs of breakout from consolidation visible.
recommendations.detail: Viewer Saikumar asked about Piramal Pharma at Rs 268 and Midwest at Rs 1,286. Kutumba Rao said: 'Piramal Pharma, definitely buy. No fear at all. Signs of breakout from consolidation are visible. Definitely buy.'
Part of the same question from Saikumar. Kutumba Rao said: 'Midwest -- wait and watch for now.'

recommendations.note: Power stocks will perform brilliantly in the next 3-5 years. Any power sector ETF is a good investment.
recommendations.detail: A viewer asked about Grow Power ETF. Kutumba Rao said: 'Power stocks will perform brilliantly in the next three to five years. There is a good opportunity. So any ETF catering to the power sector, you can invest.'

recommendations.note: Still recommending strongly. Given as investment idea at Vijayawada workshop, up Rs 300+ since. Can cross Rs 2,000 in 6-8 months.
recommendations.detail: Viewer Pramila asked about Paytm, Godrej Consumer, and Shilpa Medicare. Kutumba Rao said: 'I still recommend Paytm. We already gave it as an investment idea at the Vijayawada workshop. It has risen over 300 from there, but still, I have very high confidence -- the stock can cross 2,000 in the next six to eight months.'

recommendations.note: Not worth a fresh entry. Banks in sleeping mode. Wait for dividend record dates.
recommendations.detail: Viewer Manga Santosh asked about Union Bank and Coal India. Kutumba Rao said: 'Union Bank -- not a stock worth buying for fresh entry. All banks have gone into sleeping mode. Wait. Look at dividend record dates and then decide.'
